question: Between microsoft/vscode and octocat/Hello-World, which has more open issues, and by how much?

content_blocks.text: I'll look up both repositories at the same time!

Here's the comparison:

| Repository | Open Issues (incl. PRs) |
|---|---|
| microsoft/vscode | 19,804 |
| octocat/Hello-World | 6,901 |

**microsoft/vscode** has more open issues, surpassing octocat/Hello-World by **12,903**. Note that both counts include pull requests, not just standalone issues.
